name: Octavia
description: Octavia Mallet addon (opt-in): Overguard from damage, card rows and an optional forced threat level. Replaces the loose Inject copy of the same addon.

mallet.threat_level.label: Forced threat level
mallet.threat_level.scope: The Mallet always draws enemy attention at this threat level (0 to 5). Turn the Octavia script off in SCRIPTS for the game's own changing level.
